column3: “Built” is rendered “fortified,” and the negative purpose clause as “in order to prevent anyone.”
“A covenant” is rendered “a treaty”; NASB supplies “Let there be” and “as.” “Go up from on me” is rendered “withdraw from me.”
“Struck down” is rendered “conquered,” and “the stores of the cities” as “the store cities.”
“Took” is rendered “brought,” and “built” as “had been building” and “fortified.”
“The Cushites and the Libyans” is rendered “the Ethiopians and the Lubim.”
“Roving about” is rendered “move to and fro,” and “to show himself strong with” as “strongly support.” NASB adds “Indeed” and “surely.”
“The house of the stocks” is rendered “prison,” and “crushed” as “oppressed.”
“There!” is rendered “And now … behold”; “matters” is rendered “acts.”
“To upwards” is rendered “severe”; NASB supplies “but” for “for.”
“Graves” is rendered “tomb,” and “dug” as “cut out.” “Mixed as ointment of work” is rendered “blended by the perfumers' art.”
